policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Testing for Crohn’s Disease, Ulcerative Colitis and Irritable Bowel Syndrome

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • Fecal calprotectin testing (CPT code 83993) IS REIMBURSABLE when any one of the following conditions or symptoms are present: – Abdominal or pelvic pain – Abnormal weight loss – Anal spasm or anal fistula – Anemia – Constipation – Crohn’s disease – Diarrhea – Duodenitis – Dysphagia – Early satiety – Fecal incontinence – Flatulence – Functional dyspepsia – Gastro-esophageal reflux disease – Heartburn – Hemorrhage of anus or rectum – Irritable bowel syndrome – Malnutrition or malabsorption – Melena – Nausea and vomiting – Other specified diseases of the intestine, anus or rectum – Oral aphthae – Noninfective gastroenteritis and colitis – Symptoms and signs involving the digestive system – Ulcerative colitis – Use of steroids, immunosuppressants or immunomodulators • Fecal lactoferrin measurement (CPT code 83630, CPT code 83631) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • The use of the following serologic markers ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE in individuals with Crohn’s Disease, ulcerative colitis or irritable bowel syndrome: – Antibody to Escherichia coli outer membrane porin C (anti-OmpC) (CPT code 83520) – Antibody to Pseudomonas fluorescens-associated sequence I2 (anti-I2) (CPT code 83520) – Anti-CBir1 flagellin antibody (anti-cBir1) (CPT code 83520) – Antichitobioside antibodies (ACCA IgA) (CPT code 83516) – Anti-cytolethal distending toxin B (anti-CdtB) and anti-vinculin antibodies (CPT code 0176U) – Antilaminaribioside antibodies (ALCA IgG) (CPT code 83516) – Antimannobioside antibodies (AMCA IgG) (CPT code 83516) – Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA) (CPT code 86036, CPT code 86037) – Anti-Saccharomyces cerevisiae antibody (ASCA) (CPT code 86671) – Perinuclear anti-neutrophilic cytoplasmic antibody (pANCA) (CPT code 86021, CPT code 86255) – Pyruvate kinase M2 (PKM2) (CPT code 83520) • The use of diagnostic algorithm-based testing (CPT code 0164U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Genetic testing for inflammatory bowel disease, including Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, (CPT code 0203U*) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Immunoglobulin G (IgG) based food sensitivity testing (e.g., inFoods® IBS Test) (CPT code 0598U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
